args.sql_query:
WITH first_30_days AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT date
    FROM calendar
    ORDER BY date
    LIMIT 30
),
unavailable_per_listing AS (
    SELECT
        listing_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS unavailable_days
    FROM calendar
    WHERE available = false
      AND date IN (SELECT date FROM first_30_days)
    GROUP BY listing_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS listings_unavailable_all_30_days
FROM unavailable_per_listing
WHERE unavailable_days = 30;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS listings_fully_unavailable
FROM (
  SELECT c.listing_id
  FROM calendar c, start s
  WHERE c.date >= s.d AND c.date < s.d + 30
  GROUP BY c.listing_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.available) = 30
) t
